capabilities: Chat with specific vault files and folders selected via @-mentions
Apply AI-suggested document edits with one click
Run semantic vault search (RAG) to surface relevant notes as context
Add website links, images, and YouTube transcripts as chat context
Configure models via API keys, subscriptions, local Ollama, or MCP servers
extras: README warns the plugin is not under active development and lists community-maintained forks in a Community Fork Collection. It also warns of Anthropic banning accounts that use subscription OAuth through third-party clients as of January 2026. Full documentation lives on an external docs site; Gemini API is recommended as a free option. Requires a recent Obsidian installer version.
motivation: The README frames it as avoiding the need to "put so much context information for each query" that is already in the vault, unifying note-taking and content creation.
problem: Asking ChatGPT normally requires re-pasting background information that already exists in your vault on every query.

relations.evidence: Inspired by Cursor AI and ChatGPT Canvas, this plugin unifies your note-taking and content creation
Inspired by Cursor AI and ChatGPT Canvas, this plugin unifies your note-taking and content creation
Run open-source LLMs and embedding models locally with Ollama for complete privacy and offline usage.
Connect your Claude or OpenAI account directly (no API key required)

requires.name: API key from OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Groq, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Azure OpenAI, and others
Ollama or LM Studio for local models

summary: AI chat assistant that takes vault files, links, and images as context, applies suggested edits in one click, and adds semantic vault search.
